desc: Derive the fixed-subarray minimum cost as the sum of running-prefix-maximum minus each original element.
Design and prove an amortized O(n) sliding-window deque of compressed maximum plateaus, including precise updates for both endpoints.
Validate the deque implementation on both provided examples and against brute force on small random inputs.
Implement `Solution.countNonDecreasingSubarrays` with the validated algorithm and document its invariants.
Identify numeric bounds; Python integers safely hold all costs and counts.
